author: /root/llvm_strategy
changes: Use original non-phi order only after complete preflight proves every operand handle is already available; otherwise retain original Kahn dependency schedule and cycle rejection.
invariant: Every non-phi dependency is a parameter, a precreated phi, an earlier instruction in the same block (mandatory existing check), or a non-phi in an earlier textual block. Original block order then gives a topological schedule and preserves per-block effect order. All type, CFG, name, phi edge and dominance checks complete before the early return.

test_commands.command: CARGO_TARGET_DIR=$PWD/target cargo test -p zil-llvm-api --features native -j2 --test schedule_cp06 --test machine210 --test allocation211 --test builder210 --test native211 --test local_names_cp06
CARGO_TARGET_DIR=$PWD/target cargo test -p zil-llvm-api -j2 --test schedule_cp06 --test machine210 --test allocation211
CARGO_TARGET_DIR=$PWD/target cargo clippy -p zil-llvm-api --features native --all-targets -j2 -- -D warnings

new_test_coverage: All six textual permutations of three dependent non-entry blocks
Natural and forward textual phi-loop orders
Sixteen Linux O0/O2 compilation/link/execution checks with expected 42 and empty stdout/stderr
Ordered stores without SSA results retain observable order
Unreachable non-phi dependency cycle rejects in both orders; breaking cycle restores acceptance
Natural order still rejects invalid phi predecessor multiset and non-dominating use
evidence_level: Machine-model and target-machine behavior tests; not full ZIL-language or product acceptance
